videos.t: This Is How You Build A Tall Bike
videos.desc:
I wanted to build a Tallbike for YEARS! 
It is actually a lot easier than it looks.
Check out how i built mine

The only thing you really need to pay attention to is to keep the angle from the forktube of you bottom bike. if you change the angle it will be very hard to stear the bike. Everything else is up to you!

This was a lot of fun and i am sure i will build more tallbikes in the future because they are a blast to make and also to ride!

Thanks for watching!!
Music by Leven Bulut.

See ya next week!

videos.t: Laura´s Maple Table - Steel base (part 2)
videos.desc:
Here is how i built the steelbase for my Maple Table
I used painters-tape to layout the shape and sticky notes to transfere the angles...cool trick if you hate math like me :)

this is my first project using a stickwelder. so the beads are not the nicest but since the base gets painted at the end i could smooth everthing up with my anglegrinder and filler.

i need to practice A LOT but it´s a very cool technique that i want to learn more about.
